2	
3	Guidance for working in this repository.
4	
5	## Project
6	
7	Spring PetClinic REST, converted from Spring `@RestController` classes to
8	**OfficeFloor function injection**. Spring's DI, security, persistence and DTOs are
9	unchanged; only the request handling is now explicit function orchestration.
10	
11	<!-- https://officefloor.net/AGENTS.md -->
12	@AGENTS.md
13

1	## OfficeFloor REST endpoints
2	
3	Applies when adding or changing REST endpoints. This project serves REST through
4	OfficeFloor Function Injection, **not** Spring MVC controllers: each endpoint is a
5	pipeline of small function classes wired together in YAML.
6	
7	- Requires the OfficeFloor Spring Boot starter in the build:
8	  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-4-starter` (Spring Boot 4.x) or
9	  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-3-starter` (Spring Boot 3.x). Without it these YAML
10	  files are inert. (Rules below track these starter versions.)
11	- Define each endpoint as a YAML file under `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/`,
12	  named `<path>.<METHOD>.yml` (e.g. `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` → `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`).
13	- One small function class per step; compose steps with `next:` and `outputs:`.
14	- Do NOT generate `@RestController`, `@GetMapping` or `@PostMapping`.
15	- Transactions: `govern: [ transaction ]` on steps, not `@Transactional`.
16	- Errors: a handler YAML in `officefloor/escalation/`, not `@ControllerAdvice`.
17	
18	### Worked example — `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`
19	
20	The whole shape of an endpoint. The sections after this one are the reference.
21	
22	`src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml`
23	
24	```yaml
25	# First step runs first. Validate before Load so an invalid body is a 400,
26	# not masked by a 404 for a missing owner.
27	validate:
28	  class: com.example.owner.ValidateOwner
29	  next: load
30	load:
31	  class: com.example.owner.LoadOwner
32	  next: apply
33	apply:
34	  class: com.example.owner.ApplyOwner
35	  govern: [ transaction ]
36	  next: save
37	save:
38	  class: com.example.owner.SaveOwner
39	  govern: [ transaction ]
40	  next: respond
41	respond:
42	  class: com.example.owner.RespondWithOwner
43	```
44	
45	```java
46	// One public method each. State moves by Out<T> (set) → @Val (read), matched by type.
47	public class ValidateOwner {
48	  public void validate(@RequestBody @Valid OwnerRequest request, Out<OwnerRequest> body) {
49	    body.set(request); // body read once here; republished for later steps
50	  }
51	}
52	public class LoadOwner {
53	  public void load(@PathVariable("ownerId") int ownerId, OwnerRepository repository,
54	      Out<Owner> ownerOut) throws OwnerNotFoundException {
55	    Owner owner = repository.findById(ownerId);
56	    if (owner == null) throw new OwnerNotFoundException(ownerId); // handled below
57	    ownerOut.set(owner);
58	  }
59	}
60	public class ApplyOwner { // @Val yields the stored object, not a copy — mutate in place
61	  public void apply(@Val OwnerRequest request, @Val Owner owner) {
62	    owner.setFirstName(request.firstName());
63	    owner.setLastName(request.lastName());
64	  }
65	}
66	public class SaveOwner {
67	  public void save(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository repository) {
68	    repository.save(owner);
69	  }
70	}
71	public class RespondWithOwner {
72	  public void respond(@Val Owner owner, ObjectResponse<OwnerResponse> response) {
73	    response.send(OwnerResponse.from(owner)); // this step responds; 200 by default
74	  }
75	}
76	```
77	
78	`src/main/resources/officefloor/escalation/com.example.owner.OwnerNotFoundException.yml`
79	
80	```yaml
81	handle:
82	  class: com.example.owner.HandleOwnerNotFound
83	```
84	
85	```java
86	public class HandleOwnerNotFound {
87	  public void handle(@Parameter OwnerNotFoundException ex,
88	      ObjectResponse<ResponseEntity<String>> response) {
89	    response.send(new ResponseEntity<>(ex.getMessage(), HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));
90	  }
91	}
92	```
93	
94	### Step wiring
95	
96	Each top-level YAML entry is a developer-chosen step name; the first is the entry
97	point. `class:` names the function. **Give each function class exactly one public
98	method** — several public methods fail at start-up unless every reference adds
99	`method:`.
100	
101	- `next: <step>` — run that step afterwards. This step's return value arrives there
102	  as `@Parameter T`.
103	- `outputs: { <name>: <step> }` — conditional branches. Declare a
104	  `@FunctionalInterface` parameter annotated `@Flow("<name>")` and call it to take the
105	  branch; not calling it short-circuits.
106	
107	### Function parameters
108	
109	Declare only what the step needs; they resolve by role:
110	
111	- `@PathVariable`, `@RequestParam`, `@RequestBody` — Spring MVC annotations work.
112	- Spring beans (repositories, mappers, services) — injected by type as normal.
113	- `ObjectResponse<T>` (`net.officefloor.web.ObjectResponse`) — send the response with
114	  `response.send(dto)`. This is how a step responds; wrap as
115	  `ObjectResponse<ResponseEntity<T>>` to set status explicitly.
116	- `@Parameter T` (`net.officefloor.plugin.section.clazz.Parameter`) — the previous
117	  step's return value, a `@Flow` argument, or a thrown escalation.
118	
119	### Passing state between steps — `Out<T>` / `@Val`
120	
121	Steps do not call each other. Beyond the single `@Parameter` hand-off, publish state
122	into a variable (`net.officefloor.plugin.variable`):
123	
124	- Producer declares `Out<T>` and calls `set(...)`; consumer declares `@Val T`.
125	- Matching is **by type** — two variables of the same type in one pipeline need a
126	  `@Qualifier` annotation to disambiguate.
127	- `@Val` yields the same object the producer stored, **not a copy** — so an `Apply`
128	  step mutates the entity in place and later steps see the change.
129	
130	### Naming
131	
132	Verb plus entity: `Load<E>` (fetch by path variable, publishes `Out<E>`, throws when
133	absent) · `Build<E>` (construct from body) · `Validate<E>` (bind and validate the body,
134	publish it) · `Apply<E>` (mutate) · `Save<E>` · `Delete<E>` · `RespondWith<E>` (200) ·
135	`RespondWith<E>Created` (201) · `RespondWithNoContent` (204).
136	
137	Keep DTOs at the edges — request body in at the first step, response DTO out at the
138	responder. Steps in between work with entities.
139	
140	### Request body and validation
141	
142	- The HTTP body can be read only once: **only one step per pipeline may bind
143	  `@RequestBody`**. A second binding fails at runtime. When later steps need it, the
144	  first step publishes it as a variable.
145	- `@Valid` runs before that step's method body, so step order decides when validation
146	  happens. Put the validating step first — otherwise a missing id returns 404 before an
147	  invalid body can return 400.
148	
149	### Transactions
150	
151	`govern: [ transaction ]` for writes, `govern: [ readonly-transaction ]` for reads,
152	listed on **every** step it covers. Both are provided by the starter. Governance spans
153	the pipeline, so the request commits once at the end.
154	
155	### Errors
156	
157	Functions throw; handlers respond. The exception must be **checked** (`extends
158	Exception`) so it appears in the `throws` clause. Put the handler in
159	`officefloor/escalation/<fully.qualified.ExceptionClass>.yml`, taking the exception as
160	`@Parameter` and responding via `ObjectResponse`. Matching is most-specific-first;
161	anything unmatched falls through to Spring `@RestControllerAdvice`.
162	
163	### Security
164	
165	Guard a whole endpoint file with a Spring Security SpEL expression:
166	
167	```yaml
168	composition:
169	  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"
170	```
171	
172	- Full reference: https://officefloor.net/llms.txt

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      properties:
        id:

          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:

      type: object
      properties:

# Overview

This project has been converted from Spring `@RestController` classes to **OfficeFloor function injection**. Each REST endpoint is a YAML pipeline under `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/` wiring together small single-method Java function classes. Spring's DI, persistence, security, and DTOs are unchanged. The DTO classes (`OwnerDto`, `OwnerFieldsDto`, `OwnerPageDto`, `ValidationMessageDto`) are **generated at build time** from `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` by the openapi-generator-maven-plugin (they do not exist as source files). Owners are created/read/updated via the single externally-tested endpoint `POST /api/owners` and `GET /api/owners/{id}`.

---

# 1. The Owner entity/model class (JPA entity)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`

Key points: `@Entity @Table(name = "owners")`, extends `Person`. Fields with Jakarta validation:
- `address` — `@NotEmpty`
- `city` — `@NotEmpty`
- `telephone` — `@NotEmpty @Digits(fraction = 0, integer = 10) @Pattern(regexp = "^[0-9]{10}$", message = "Phone number must be exactly 10 digits")`
- `pets` — `@OneToMany(cascade = ALL, mappedBy = "owner", fetch = EAGER)`

There is **no `email` field** on the entity (relevant: the acceptance test references `email`).

Full contents were read (152 lines); the load-bearing validation annotations are shown above.

## Base class

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Person.java`

`@MappedSuperclass` extends `BaseEntity`. Fields `firstName` (`@Column(name="first_name") @NotEmpty`) and `lastName` (`@Column(name="last_name") @NotEmpty`), with standard getters/setters.

---

# 2. Owner Request/Response/DTO classes

There are **no hand-written Owner DTO/Request/Response classes**. The DTOs are generated from the OpenAPI schema into package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`:
- `OwnerFieldsDto` — the request body (editable fields)
- `OwnerDto` — the response (fields + id + pets)
- `OwnerPageDto` — paginated list response
- `ValidationMessageDto` — used by the validation error handler

Generation is configured in `pom.xml` (openapi-generator-maven-plugin): `modelNameSuffix=Dto`, `modelPackage=org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`, `performBeanValidation=true`, `useJakartaEe=true`.

## OpenAPI schema (source of the DTOs)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`

`OwnerFields` schema (lines 1991-2039) — properties `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone`, all `required`. Constraints of note:
- `firstName`: minLength 1, maxLength 30, `pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"`
- `lastName`: minLength 1, maxLength 30, `pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"`
- `address`: minLength 1, maxLength 255
- `city`: minLength 1, maxLength 80
- `telephone`: minLength 1, maxLength 20, `pattern: '^[0-9]*$'`

`Owner` schema (lines 2040+) — `allOf` of `OwnerFields` plus `id` (int32, readOnly) and `pets` (array). There is **no `email` property** in the schema.

Endpoint definitions: `POST /owners` (`operationId: addOwner`, request body `OwnerFields`, 201 returns `Owner`) at lines 65-97; `GET /owners` (`listOwners`) lines 98-138; `GET /v2/owners` (`listOwnersPage`) at line 139+.

## Mapper (Owner <-> DTO)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`

---

# 3. OfficeFloor REST YAML files for owners + referenced function classes

## Create — `POST /api/owners`

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`
```yaml
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireOwnerFields
  next: normalizeTelephone
normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  next: rejectDuplicateTelephone
rejectDuplicateTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectDuplicateTelephone
  next: build
build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save
save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond
respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
```

Pipeline: RequireOwnerFields → NormalizeOwnerTelephone → RejectDuplicateTelephone → BuildOwner → SaveOwner → RespondWithOwnerCreated.

## Update — `PUT /api/owners/{ownerId}`

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml`
```yaml
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: load
load:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.LoadOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: apply
apply:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ApplyOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save
save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond
respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerUpdated
  govern: [ transaction ]
```

Pipeline: ValidateOwner → LoadOwner → ApplyOwner → SaveOwner → RespondWithOwnerUpdated.

Note the two endpoints differ in the first (validation) step: create uses `RequireOwnerFields` + telephone normalization/dedup; update uses `ValidateOwner` (bean validation via `@Valid`).

## Other owner YAMLs
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.GET.yml` — `ListOwners` (readonly-transaction)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml` — LoadOwner → RespondWithOwner (readonly)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners/{ownerId}.DELETE.yml` — DeleteOwner
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/v2/owners.GET.yml` — paginated listing
- Nested pet/visit endpoints under `owners/{ownerId}/pets/...`

## Referenced function classes (full contents captured)

All under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`:

- `RequireOwnerFields.java` — first step of POST. Reads raw `@RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto` (no `@Valid`), collects blank/missing among firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone; throws `MissingOwnerFieldsException(missing)`; republishes body via `Out<OwnerFieldsDto>`.
- `NormalizeOwnerTelephone.java` — `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto)`: strips non-digits (`replaceAll("\\D","")`), requires exactly 10 digits else throws `InvalidTelephoneException`; mutates body's telephone in place.
- `RejectDuplicateTelephone.java` — `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto, OwnerRepository)`: iterates `findAll()`, compares normalized telephones; throws `DuplicateTelephoneException` on collision.
- `BuildOwner.java` — `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto, OwnerMapper, Out<Owner>)`: `built.set(ownerMapper.toOwner(request))`.
- `ApplyOwner.java` — `service(@Val Owner, @Val OwnerFieldsDto)`: sets address, city, firstName, lastName, telephone on the loaded owner (in-place mutation).
- `SaveOwner.java` — `service(@Val Owner, OwnerRepository)`: `ownerRepository.save(owner)`.
- `LoadOwner.java` — `service(@PathVariable("ownerId") Integer, OwnerRepository, Out<Owner>)`: `Lookups.findOrNotFound(...)`, throws `NotFoundException`.
- `ValidateOwner.java` — `service(@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto, Out<OwnerFieldsDto>)`, class annotated `@Validated`; used by PUT so bean validation yields 400 before LoadOwner's 404.
- `RespondWithOwnerCreated.java` — maps to `OwnerDto`, sends `ResponseEntity.created(URI "/api/owners/{id}").body(dto)` (201).
- `RespondWithOwnerUpdated.java` — sends `ResponseEntity.status(NO_CONTENT).body(ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner))` (204 with body).
- `RespondWithOwner.java` — sends `OwnerDto` (200) for GET.

Other owner functions present (not on create/update paths): `ListOwners`, `ListOwnersPage`, `DeleteOwner`, `LoadOwnersPet`, `BuildOwnersPet`.

Escalation (error handler) classes in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/escalation/`, each wired via a YAML in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/escalation/`:

- `InvalidTelephoneException.java` — checked exception. Handler `InvalidTelephoneHandler.java` → 400 with plain message. YAML: `...InvalidTelephoneException.yml`.

There is no dedicated `OwnerTest`/`OwnerControllerTest`. Owner behavior is exercised by the black-box acceptance suite under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/`:
